blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed on site, a full menu of scratch-made pub food including pizzas, burgers, salads, and shareables, and participate in events like Oktoberfest and fantasy football draft parties. The brewery hosts live music, trivia, and other community events regularly. It is family-friendly and welcomes well-behaved dogs on the outdoor patio.
